content: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED: full support in Postgres (9.5+) and MySQL 8.0+ (InnoDB). SQLite has NO support for SKIP LOCKED or FOR UPDATE at all - SQLite locks the whole database/file on write transactions instead, so the row-claim queue pattern must degrade to a different strategy (whole-db serialization is actually fine for single-process SQLite, but breaks the 'many workers' claim design).
